title: DoorDash app and website outage, Nov 21, 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by DoorDash, any government agency, news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: DoorDash is a food-delivery service that many people use daily, and Downdetector logged more than 12,700 reports. DoorDash has not said how many customers were affected, and Downdetector counts reports, not users.
who_is_affected: People who use the DoorDash app or website, mostly in the US, from about 11 AM ET on Saturday, Nov 21, and businesses using DoorDash Drive from 11:30 AM ET. DoorDash marked both status-page incidents resolved by 2:50 PM ET but has not said when the app was fully back for everyone.

known.text: DoorDash's status page showed an increase in errors on its Drive endpoints from 11:30 AM ET on Nov 21 and a recovery update at 11:50 AM ET.
DoorDash opened a second status-page incident, 'DoorDash Health Degredation', at 11:33 AM ET, tied to its merchant orders component.
DoorDash marked the Drive incident resolved at 1:58 PM ET and said the second incident ended at 11:51 AM ET.

not_known.text: What caused the outage. DoorDash has not said; its status page says a post mortem will be posted later.
Whether it was a cyberattack. DoorDash has not said either way; the hack idea is only social-media speculation.
Whether either status-page incident caused the app and website errors, and when the app was fully back for everyone.
